objective: Create a fair company/report-group-disjoint development cohort for V13 Scratch versus V13 Warm comparison.
invariants: data/test.jsonl and canonical test are not opened by the split builder
Every validation row belongs to company/source groups absent from the full V8 training-and-validation pool
No example ID, record fingerprint, gold evidence fingerprint, company key, source digest, or source filename crosses the new train/validation boundary
Selection is deterministic and operation-balanced without ticker, company, filename, page, year, value, or question-specific rules
Original canonical train and validation files remain byte-unchanged
Outputs are new artifacts under data/tmp and are never overwritten
